card.name: Start of new section or sentence
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word at the start of a new sentence, bullet or heading in label text, often "Ins" (Insulin, Insufficiency, Inspect) or "Central". Also fires on a slash between two condition names.

modes.label: Ins- at sentence start
modes.description: The opening piece "Ins" of a word like insulin, insufficiency or inspect, starting a sentence or heading.

modes.label: Slash between conditions
modes.description: A slash joining two related condition names.
